visual_identity.color_palette: Deep burnt-umber skin with charcoal-grey osteoderms; vibrant crimson-red highlights on the tips of the horns.
visual_identity.texture: Leathery skin covered in small scales with prominent, raised bony bumps (osteoderms) along the back and sides.
visual_identity.distinguishing_marks: Two large, forward-facing brow horns; extremely tiny, vestigial arms; a deep, snub-nosed snout.

anatomy_constraints.head: Short, deep skull with thick bull-like horns; large expressive yellow eyes; muscular neck.
anatomy_constraints.limbs: Long, powerful hind legs built for sprinting; tiny, four-fingered forelimbs that are almost invisible against the body.
anatomy_constraints.body: Muscular, athletic frame; a thick tail base indicating powerful 'caudofemoralis' muscles for speed.

visual_logic.subject: A determined, fast-moving Carnotaurus in a mid-stride sprint.
visual_logic.action: Running across an ocher-colored coastal flat, kicking up dry silt.
visual_logic.environment: Background features the sparse, salt-tolerant vegetation of a Late Cretaceous lagoon under a bright, high-contrast sun.

personality: The 'Bull-Runner'—highly energetic, competitive, and incredibly fast. He has a bold, confident presence.
